note: Files outside core/elements/** that wire raw pointer drag, arrow-key navigation, a hand-built focus trap or a manual interactive ARIA role: the low-level interaction plumbing an element already standardizes, or should. An entry here is NOT a permanent exemption — nothing is internal-only, consumer apps should be able to reach the same capability core ships. Every entry must reference the issue that promotes it to a core element or utility; when that issue lands, remove the entry. If a new file trips this test, either compose from an existing element or file a promotion issue (like #393/#394/#395) before adding an entry (core/STANDARDS.md, 'Composition: check before you build').

site/gallery/gallery.js.reason: Inspector-drawer resize handle: pointer drag + arrow-key resize duplicates pk-splitter's own behavior. Temporary, pending #391 (swap to pk-splitter). Remove this entry when #391 lands.

modules/layout-builder/layout-builder.js.reason: Arrow/Home/End move the selected canvas node up/down/in/out in the document tree (structural keyboard reorder). Temporary, pending #395 (generalize into pk-tree/pk-sortable or a shared utility). Remove this entry when #395 lands.
